name: ZN 10-Year Auction Intraday Reaction
description: Detects 10-year Treasury auction events on ZN at 1:00 PM ET using a |1-min return| > 0.02% threshold. Measures forward returns at +5, +15, and +30 minutes post-auction. Displays average absolute move at each interval in a summary table and bar chart, with clickable event markers for each detected auction.
source:
# =============================================================================
# ZN INTRADAY REACTION TO 10-YEAR TREASURY AUCTION RESULTS (1:00 PM ET)
# =============================================================================
# Detect auction events: bars at 1:00 PM ET with |1-min return| > 0.02%
# Measure forward returns at +5, +15, +30 minutes after detected auction
# Liquidity-based rollover, no price adjustment (intraday levels)
# =============================================================================

# === DATA SOURCE (1Min bars) ===
src = market_data_source()()

# === CONTINUOUS CONTRACT ===
cont = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment, i_offset=0)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)
close = cont.c
open_price = cont.o

# === 1:00 PM ET BAR DETECTION ===
bar_ts = index()
bar_hour = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.hour, timezone='America/New_York')(bar_ts)
bar_minute = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.minute, timezone='America/New_York')(bar_ts)
is_1pm = (bar_hour == 13) and (bar_minute == 0)

# === 1-MIN RETURN AT 1:00 PM BAR ===
ret_1m = (close - open_price) / open_price
abs_ret_1m = abs(ret_1m)

# === AUCTION EVENT DETECTION ===
# Flag as auction if absolute 1-min return exceeds 0.02% (roughly 2 ticks)
is_auction = is_1pm and (abs_ret_1m > 0.0002)

# === FORWARD RETURNS AT +5, +15, +30 BARS (MINUTES) ===
fwd_5 = forward_returns(period=5)(close)
fwd_15 = forward_returns(period=15)(close)
fwd_30 = forward_returns(period=30)(close)

# === FILTERED AUCTION RETURNS ===
auction_ret_1m = where(is_auction, ret_1m)
auction_fwd_5 = where(is_auction, fwd_5)
auction_fwd_15 = where(is_auction, fwd_15)
auction_fwd_30 = where(is_auction, fwd_30)

# === ABSOLUTE MOVES FOR SUMMARY & BAR CHART ===
auction_abs_5 = where(is_auction, abs(fwd_5))
auction_abs_15 = where(is_auction, abs(fwd_15))
auction_abs_30 = where(is_auction, abs(fwd_30))

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS
# =============================================================================

# --- Summary Table: Avg Absolute Move at Each Interval + Auction Count ---
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='ZN Avg Absolute Move After 10-Year Auction',
        row_size=1,
        col_size=4,
        row_headers=['Auction Events'],
        col_headers=['Avg |Move| 5min', 'Avg |Move| 15min', 'Avg |Move| 30min', 'Auction Count'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat)
        ]
    ),
    category='10Y Auction Reaction'
)(auction_abs_5, auction_abs_15, auction_abs_30, auction_fwd_5)

# --- Bar Chart: Avg Absolute Move by Interval After Auction ---
xy_bars(
    title='ZN Avg Absolute Move by Interval After Auction',
    category='10Y Auction Reaction',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    data_labels=True,
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=3,
    y_axis_label='Avg |Move|',
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='5-Min Mark', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='15-Min Mark', color=Color.Indigo),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='30-Min Mark', color=Color.Slate)
    ])
)(auction_abs_5, auction_abs_15, auction_abs_30)

# --- Event Markers: Each Detected Auction with Return at Each Interval ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='10-Year Treasury Auction Results',
        icon=Icon.BellRingIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, title='1-Min Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='5-Min Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='15-Min Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='30-Min Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3)
        ]
    )
)(is_auction, auction_ret_1m, auction_fwd_5, auction_fwd_15, auction_fwd_30)
